'''Trebold Raynor''' was the founder of [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]]. Raynor owned a fabled pickaxe that became known as the [[Platinum Pickaxe]], and [[Gan Alno]], a later head of the company, hired treasure hunters to locate the item on [[Trebold Raynor's homeworld|Raynor's homeworld]].<ref name="Platinum Pickaxe" />
